paragraphs: The Defender P400e is a plug-in hybrid variant of the L663-generation Defender, introduced in 2020. It combines the Ingenium AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine — with an electric motor, producing a combined output of 404 PS. Production was limited to the 2020 model year and the 110 body style only, making it a relatively rare variant in the Defender range. The Defender P400e is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P + electric motor engines for every Defender P400e on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine paired with a plug-in hybrid electric motor, fitted exclusively to the L663-generation Defender 110 in 2020. We rebuild the internal combustion engine component to the same standard as our other Defender petrol rebuilds, with timing chains, bearings and gaskets replaced as standard.

compatibility.intro: The P400e is a distinct PHEV variant that was only produced for the 2020 model year and exclusively in the 110 body style. Unlike the standard P400, the P400e features a plug-in hybrid drivetrain with additional electrical components. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
